cs.t: I haven’t bought a Windows PC in 10 years so I thought it was time to upgrade the old tower I had in the closet. I stumbled across Mini PCs and was surprised at how cheap they were so I brought one. Turns out they were lying about the clock speed, citing 3.4Ghz when it was actually 1.7GHz. I contacted their support to say the description was wrong but they said it was right. Don’t buy from KAMRUI.
